verbose.description: Verbosity level (0 = silent, 1 = basic, 2+ = increasing detail). Mirrors -v/--verbose repetition.

output_format.description: Output format for statistics: 'csv', 'json', or 'none' (default = no stats output). Must be exactly one.

iterations.description: Number of times to replay the PCAP. Use -1 for infinite loop.

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass directly to the drool command (e.g., ['--delay', '100ms']). Each item must be a string representing one argument.
